keen.name: KeenGamer – GTA 6 Trophy Guide, Platinum Roadmap

stages.title: Story playthrough
stages.summary: Play the five chapters. Grab the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house, scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study animals as you go, and take side quests as they appear.

stages.title: Collectibles cleanup
stages.summary: Unfog the map by plane, then sweep for meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries.

stages.title: Activities & challenges
stages.summary: Ranges, drone and street races, stunts, side-quest finales, easter eggs and 50 of 80 challenges.

stages.title: Heists & final grind
stages.summary: Partner robberies, gang operations and bank vaults, then laundering, shopping, garages and the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Pops once the other 54 trophies are unlocked. Everything is single-player: there is no online or DLC trophy in the list, and PowerPyx rates the run about 4/10 over roughly 200 hours with one playthrough.
steps: Finish the story (stage 1).
Clean up collectibles, activities and side quests (stages 2–3).
Finish the 100% checklist and money trophies (stage 4).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy that unlocks when you clear Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed.
steps: Play the opening of Chapter 1 through Gone Fishing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. PowerPyx reports it pops once you finish What's in the Bag?, the first main mission of Chapter 2. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Do Lucia's balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.
Make a manual save at the end of the chapter.
Complete What's in the Bag? to unlock.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. According to PowerPyx it unlocks after Welcome to Vice City, the opening main mission of Chapter 3.
steps: Finish Chapter 2 and play Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. PowerPyx says it arrives after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
steps: Finish Chapter 3, then play Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. PowerPyx lists the unlock at Starting From Zero, the closing main mission. There is no mission replay, so keep a save before the last missions.
steps: Save before the final missions.
Complete Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for the ending, reported by PowerPyx to unlock alongside Top Of The World, Ma at Starting From Zero. Afterwards you return to free roam, where the 100% checklist becomes visible.
steps: Complete the final main mission.
Open Progress → Stats → 100% Completion afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission. Unmissable.
steps: Play Chapter 2 up to and through Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Unmissable.
steps: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission. Unmissable.
steps: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners in Chapter 4. Unmissable.
steps: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Unmissable.
steps: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory, which PowerPyx places in Chapter 5. Unmissable.
steps: Complete Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, but lenient: PowerPyx puts the checklist near 60% true completion. Story progress counts even though the list only appears after the credits. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need every entry; elsewhere a share is enough.
steps: Any 100 optional missions (purple icons, or black icons with pink letters).
Scan 200 of 277 base vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals.
15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 of 33 underwater finds.
30 of 40 races, all 42 range golds, all 42 drone trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of 397 stunts, mixed freely across four types: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. PowerPyx finds Under the Bridges fastest. The optional challenge on each stunt does not matter; doing it once counts. The 100% checklist wants 300.
steps: Track counts in Progress → Activities → Stunts.
Map → Exploration → Stunt Spots lists found and done stunts by name.
Fly a helicopter or plane under bridges for quick numbers.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts nine activity types, and you will touch most of them through the story or the 100% list anyway. Check Progress → Activities for any you still lack.
steps: Fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool.
Basketball hoops, a video game at home or an arcade.
Win any race or drone race, perform any stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold on every range challenge: 42 medals spread over 12 ranges (PowerPyx, GMTreks). Range practice also levels Focus, which helps with Gunslinger, so start early.
steps: Find the 12 ranges on the Activities map filter.
Clear each range's challenges at gold.
Retry the toughest ones once Focus is higher.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx counts 14 Top Fun drone locations holding 42 races; win at every location. All 42 drone time trials are on the 100% list, so you can finish them in one sweep.
steps: Visit all 14 drone race locations.
Win at each; finish all 42 trials for 100%.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win any 20 of the 40 unique races. Their blue icons appear within about 100 m, and the 100% list asks for 30 wins, so this comes on the way.
steps: Map → Activities → Racing shows found races.
Win 20 different ones (30 for 100%).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Some time after Feng Shui (Meet Cal) in Chapter 1, Cal texts you and a purple fishing marker appears west of Key Lento. Win that fishing contest.
steps: Finish Feng Shui (Meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text, go to the purple marker west of Key Lento.
Out-fish Cal.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one of four video games. Three (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind) run on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade cabinets. Challenges inside the game are not needed.
steps: Use the controllers at the home TV.
Play one game through all of its levels.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. During Chapter 3 Andy calls, then texts an address in Belville. Five quests end with Puff Puff Pass, which unlocks the trophy. Still available after the story.
steps: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3).
Pay the Cellerica Fee, then Peach!.
Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon, Key Lento) calls after Island Dreams in Chapter 1 and sends you diving for treasure: seven shipwrecks in total, searched with the metal detector. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again in Chapter 2–3, so it is not missable.
steps: Finish Island Dreams (Work for Kenton).
Dive the purple chest markers and bring the treasure back.
Clear all 7 wrecks; track in Progress → Characters → Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five quests open at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, and they stay after the story.
steps: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats.
The Impaler, then Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only some open-world strands count: named contacts such as Moses, Tyrone, Andy and Billy do not. PowerPyx confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete so far and says more remain to be found. The trophy tracker shows how many count, and strands remain after the credits.
steps: Kirk: Skunk Ape, Tree Effigies, Mr. Mangrove.
Kyle: McKittrick Farm, chemicals, Buddy?.
Yago: street races; Pilot Pete: plane and deliveries.
Watch the trophy's counter for the rest.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens with Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3, which also gives the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars he wants (the Zorrusso is done in the mission). Scan cars with WAiNK to check the list; Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels are good hunting grounds.
steps: Map → Robberies → Randy's Wish List.
Scan or enter a listed car, drive it to the RK icon in west Vice City.
Deliver undamaged for more pay.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, purple Synthetic Lab markers appear in Vice City. Wreck enough labs in Take Out Kitty Litter and Tyrone hands you Spin On This, the trophy mission.
steps: Destroy the marked labs as Jason.
Complete Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Chapter 1 only: the balcony meditation at Jason's house.
trophies.guide: The list's only possible missable. In Chapter 1, PowerPyx saw Lucia mention meditating in the kitchen the morning after Down to Earth; follow her to the balcony and accept. It adds to the counter but is not marked as a spot, so it is unclear whether it is required: do it to be safe. The rest are 18 spots at 10 places (each counts once per character).
steps: Chapter 1: talk to Lucia in the morning, follow her to the balcony, Accept.
Later, bring your partner to each spot and meditate as both.
Track in Progress → Collections → Exploration → Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, Bret Vogel texts Jason about Veteran Hunted in Lummox County and gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle. His Target Decks (15) send you after specific animals; which one triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed, but all 15 are on the 100% list.
steps: Do Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) as Jason.
Work through the Target Decks (Map → Activities).
Bring the animals back to Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: There are 18 card sets with 480 cards in all, 18–36 per set. Fill any three for the trophy; the 100% list wants 15. Some cards appear in more than one place.
steps: Pick the three smallest sets first.
Use PowerPyx's set maps for locations.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app. An on-screen prompt appears when one is near and you are on foot. Types include 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags.
steps: Walk city blocks and watch for the nearby-scan prompt.
Landmarks and sculptures cluster in Vice City.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Any 50 of 80 challenges; the 100% list asks for 70. Many finish themselves as you play, so leave this near the end and then pick the easiest ones left.
steps: Progress → Challenges shows each one's status.
Mop up the quickest remaining ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters can roam together after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). With your partner along, reach four stars and escape the red heat zone. PowerPyx suggests a sports bike or the rail tunnel north of Ambrosia; bank vault jobs in Chapter 4 give four stars anyway.
steps: Call your partner, then raise four stars.
Escape the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner along, rob three robbery targets in a row while the wanted level stays on. PowerPyx uses the three jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Chapter 3), with armour and sticky bombs. The unlock lags about 30 s; hit a fourth shop if needed.
steps: Bring armour, sticky bombs and healing.
Rob 3 shops without losing the stars.
Wait ~30 s after the third.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK discovers it, no driving needed. Stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic, boats and aircraft. You need 200 base models for 100%, so start in Chapter 1.
steps: Hold the WAiNK shortcut and scan new vehicles.
Check totals in Progress → Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five takedowns inside one Combat Focus slow-down. PowerPyx advises topping up Focus (food, shower), using Adrenaline, body armour and an accurate rifle such as the Duke 556 on gang operation criminals; police, soldiers and civilians seem not to count. It gets easier at Focus level 4.
steps: Buff Focus, equip armour and a rifle.
Line up gang members, trigger Focus, drop 5 quickly.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner docked at a VCIA boarding bridge (planes parked on the apron do not count). PowerPyx recommends gate E3/E4: enter by the stairs beside the bridge, go up to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away.
steps: Break through the airfield fence to gate E3/E4.
Board, reverse out, take off.
Fly 1 km clear of the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank. PowerPyx finds them at the south end of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of Mariana County. Get in and fire on a few enemies.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station.
Enter a tank and shoot until it unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) gives the Snap Gun. Pick a back door with it, find the safe code note, empty the safe, and wipe the CCTV and alarm in the back room. PowerPyx used Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Snap Gun the back door; never kick it.
Read the safe code, loot the safe.
Destroy footage and disable the alarm, then leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Vault jobs open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…. Tail a security van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open and pass one bag to your partner. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000. There are 8 vaults (all needed for 100%), paying up to $205,000 each.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is….
Buy van tips from Yasmani, follow the van.
Rob 5 vaults and shake the four stars.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a big bank vault counts, so it unlocks with That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4. Earlier, block an armored truck near a Vice City bank, sticky-bomb its back doors and escape the red heat zone.
steps: Sticky-bomb a truck's rear door, or rob a vault.
Escape the heat zone or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear all black fog from the map. A plane is quickest; doing this first also reveals activity and collectible icons for the cleanup.
steps: Take a plane and fly grid lines over every fogged area.
Check the map for any last dark patch.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run 39 operations (yellow icons). One per gang earns the trophy; all 39 are on the 100% list. Progress → Gangs shows how many of each you have hit.
steps: Open Progress → Gangs to see who is left.
Rob one operation of each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: At the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, order an Apple Martini and drink it standing by the bar.
steps: Go to Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy and drink an Apple Martini at the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Only the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom works. Once you own the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, Chapter 3), hack it, drive through the front window and keep going down the street until it pops.
steps: Get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3.
Clone the blue Banshee, crash out through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Kingpin Bowling respawns later if you miss a valuable.
trophies.guide: Take all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling), then lose the police. Anything you miss can be taken when the robbery respawns.
steps: Luxury watch in the south-east office.
Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun, north-east table.
Safe in the north-east hallway office (code 0300 or sticky bomb).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength on Jason and Lucia together. Work out at a gym (or at home after the story) with your partner along: when one trains, the other gains too.
steps: Buy a gym membership; bring your partner.
Train until both Strength meters are full.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your criminal profile (the trophy shows the count). Turn on Criminal Profile HUD notifications. Robberies and fights all add to it, so it usually comes passively. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile.
steps: Settings → UI → HUD Notifications → Criminal Profile on.
Keep playing; check the counter near the end.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Rob the prologue's Payday Loans in Little Cuba again, alone as Lucia, and escape on foot. Payday robberies open after Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3. The unlock waits until you are well out of the search area.
steps: Go solo as Lucia to Payday Loans, Little Cuba.
Empty the 3 cash drawers.
Run away on foot until it unlocks.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A UFO easter egg on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2 AM, alone. If a blinking car sits by the road, follow the path into the woods, help the woman the UFO drops, and walk her back to her car. Not a guaranteed spawn.
steps: Arrive solo after 2 AM; look for the blinking car.
Follow the trail to the light, talk to the woman.
Return to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds. Crowded spots such as Ocean Beach make it quick.
steps: Ride a bike through a busy promenade.
Kick 10 people inside a minute.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Chapter 3) unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani pays best) until you have laundered $250,000 in total. Bank vaults in Chapter 4 make this fast.
steps: Get the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check.
Fence marked bills with Yasmani.
Vaults pay up to $205,000 a run.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spending is cumulative across every shop type. Guns, car mods and tattoos cost the most, so they get you there fastest.
steps: Upgrade weapons at Ammu-Nation.
Mod cars at mod shops; get tattoos.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages sold in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, about $160,000 together (the 4 story garages do not count). The app installs after Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
steps: Finish Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses).
Buy all 8 garages in the app.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives with the Chapter 2 mission that introduces Moses. Each garage adds parking slots, so buy garages first, then respray and register stolen cars at Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn.
steps: Buy garages for parking space (see Little Boxes).
Respray and register 10 cars with Moses.
